text: I'm convinced nobody knows this toddler tub exists because it took me almost a month to find it. I kept finding tubs for infants and babies up to twelve months, but I couldn't find a true toddler-size tub for a one-year-old. Then I found this Shnuggle toddler tub, and it's actually made for ages one to three. My baby girl outgrew her baby tub so fast, and she's still too small for the regular bathtub. I love that this gives her her own space that's actually sized for her. And it's made with safety in mind. There's a supportive backrest, non-slip feet, and an easy-drain plug. If your little one is at or near the toddler stage, this is one of those products I'd save because I genuinely wish I had found it sooner.
